design.decision: Whether to lead a [K] into an unseen [A] to bank points and set up the suit.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first [K] lead; opponents happily take it with an [A].
design.rationale: Unlike leading an [A], which is almost always safe, leading a [K] is a real risk, so this lead payoff creates a decision rather than paying for an automatic play.
design.draftText: +20 contract points when your team leads a [K]

critic.concerns: Rank-only near-duplicate of seed-ace-lead, but leading a [K] is a real risk, so it creates a real decision.

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-lead-rank-k-pts); credited to both sources.
